description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Shared_Inheritance' that provides methods to manage inheritance features in the Smarty templating engine, including compiling inheritance initialization code and registering post-compile callbacks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Shared_Inheritance
classes.description: Provides shared methods for handling inheritance in Smarty templates, specifically for {extends} and {block} tags.

methods.name: postCompile
methods.description: Compiles inheritance initialization code and adds it as prefix code to the template, optionally initializing child sequence.

methods.name: registerInit
methods.description: Registers a post-compile callback to initialize inheritance data after compilation.
